The '''FC-6''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] model produced by [[Razalon/Legends|Razalon]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The FC-6 was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Apprentice's Shadow Pack.
